pages.text: The $(item)miner's post$(): made with a pickaxe. Pickaxes of any make go in its stock.

pages.name: Mine
pages.text: Stone walls, logs in front. Pickaxes in the stock.

pages.title: How It Digs
pages.text: Nothing is dug from the world. Ore shows on the walls, the miner breaks it, the wall is rock again.$(br2)Use the post to set the $(thing)height$() it digs at, down to the bottom of the world wherever the mine stands, and to turn off what I do not want. Torches quicken it. Fortune and Silk Touch count.
The $(item)nether miner's post$() wants netherrack in the making, and a shaft of nether stone. It works in any world. Quartz, gold, glowstone, and now and then the old debris.
A $(item)cask$() holds 16 buckets of what a post gives as a liquid. Stand it on a mine's stock or basket, or beside a fenced post.
A $(item)pump$() in the middle of a mine's floor draws lava into the casks. Only at the very bottom of the world, or at any height in the nether one. It does not run dry.
